title: Podcasting For Affiliate Marketing with Tom Hunt
description:
Tom Hunt is the host of my favourite podcast, Confessions of a B2B Marketer. He is also the founder of bCast which is a podcast host and he runs Fame.so which is an agency that helps B2B companies become famous in their niche with podcasting. 

I wanted to ask Tom questions about his B2B experience in how it can apply to B2C affiliate marketing. If you are thinking about launching a podcast, follow Tom, consume his social content and learn more about what he does at Fame.so
